retrievalProfile.description: A duotone portrait-driven layout featuring large-scale vertical typography and secondary text masked with photographic imagery.
excludeWhen: clean sans-serif corporate branding is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a subject tinted in a monochromatic purple/violet hue, featuring a dominant vertical text block on the left and a secondary bold text block in the lower right that acts as a window to a warmer, full-color version of the same portrait.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic purple background vs. warm-toned masked text
Large vertical sans-serif vs. horizontal bold display type
Soft-focus portrait vs. sharp-edged geometric typography
Primary subject gaze vs. secondary subject repetition within letters
coreInvariants: Vertical text alignment on the left margin
Text-masking effect in the bottom right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait filling the entire frame, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large vertical text block on the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes of the portrait, moves down the vertical text on the left, and settles on the masked text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with the subject's hair and face.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purple mid-tones; high value contrast between the dark hair and light skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for vertical text
Extra-bold, high-impact weight for masked text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical text is rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Small lowercase letters interspersed within the vertical uppercase string
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between vertical orientation and horizontal masking.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the left text
The image-masking in the bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the masked text.
Appropriate for the vertical side-aligned text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a person with long hair, applying a monochromatic purple/violet duotone filter with high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large vertical sans-serif text block on the left in grey. In the bottom right, add bold horizontal text that acts as a clipping mask to reveal a warm-toned, full-color version of the original portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the background strictly monochromatic purple?
Is the left-side text oriented vertically?
Does the bottom-right text contain a photographic mask?
Is the font choice a clean, bold sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist name or album title from the reference.
Ensure the masked image inside the text is a different color grade than the background.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is rotated correctly.
Verify the color contrast between the purple background and the yellow masked text.
Ensure the portrait features are not obscured by the text in a way that ruins the composition.
Confirm the sans-serif fonts are bold and modern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Purple Duotone Portrait + Vertical Left-Aligned Sans + Bottom-Right Image-Masked Bold Type
